info.title: dac-plane Surface API
info.description: Surface API v1 (ADR-0007). Commands map one-to-one onto application commands; mutating requests require Idempotency-Key, and commands that change an existing record require If-Match with its ETag. Errors are RFC 9457 problems.

post.description: With agent_id the task is delegated to that active agent and records the revision current at submission; providers the body omits come from that revision. Delegation to a missing or retired agent is refused with 422, and with 503 until the database is migrated.

201.description: The submission. Replaying the same Idempotency-Key and body returns it again.

post.summary: Complete a spend-governed submission or rework

200.description: The submission with its receipt and dispatch.

post.description: If-Match carries the spend challenge version.

202.description: Cancellation recorded; the stop is confirmed by later events.

201.description: The review, with rework when changes were requested.

get.summary: Read an attempt of a task
Read or stream a task's events

200.description: A page of events (application/json) or a Server-Sent Events stream (text/event-stream) whose ids are cursors; a reset event carries next_cursor.
Open requests on tasks the principal may read.

post.description: If-Match carries the attention request version.

get.summary: Read or stream the tenant's events

200.description: A page of events (application/json) or a Server-Sent Events stream (text/event-stream) whose ids are cursors; a reset event carries next_cursor.

201.description: The migration pass. Replaying the same Idempotency-Key and body returns it again.

Location.description: URL of the created migration pass.

200.description: The migration pass and its current preview evidence, when present.

post.summary: Execute a freshly previewed migration pass
Cancel a migration pass before execution

204.description: The authority grant is revoked. An exact replay has the same result.

post.description: Creates an active agent at revision 1. Its default providers must be registered for the tenant in the runtime and environment roles. Every principal of the tenant reads it; only its creator revises or retires it.

201.description: The agent. Replaying the same Idempotency-Key and body returns it again.

200.description: The tenant's agents, retired ones included, oldest first.
The agent at its current revision.

put.description: Replaces the whole profile as the next revision. Tasks already delegated keep the revision they were delegated to. Only the principal that created the agent revises it, and a retired agent is not revised. If-Match carries the agent version.

200.description: The agent at its new revision.

post.description: Stops new delegation to the agent and frees its name. Its revisions and tasks stay readable. Only the principal that created the agent retires it. If-Match carries the agent version.

get.description: The profile the agent had at one revision, such as the one a task was delegated to.

post.description: Registers a connection, owned by the caller, to an account at an external application served by a connector provider registered for the tenant. The response carries the consent URL when the connector answered; the owner opens it and then completes the connection. The surface, the runtime and the model never see the credential.

201.description: The connection, authorizing, and its consent URL. Replaying the same Idempotency-Key and body returns the connection again with a new URL.

post.description: Asks the connector for a new consent URL for one of the caller's connections, to finish a first consent or renew one. It changes no record. An Idempotency-Key replays the same URL; use a new key to renew it.

200.description: The consent URL and its expiry.

post.description: Asks the connector whether the owner's consent finished and records the account it reports. A consent not finished is 409 authorization-pending; a failed one is 422 authorization-failed. If-Match carries the connection version.

Revokes every grant of the connection in one transaction, then asks the connector to revoke and destroy the credential. 200 with the removed connection once the connector confirmed; 202 with the connection still removing when it could not be reached, and removing it again repeats the revocation. If-Match carries the connection version.

202.description: The connection, removing: its credential is not yet revoked at the connector.

get.description: The tools the connection's connector offers now, each the governed action class connector.<name>.

post.description: Lets the work of an active agent, or of a task the connection's owner owns, call some of the connection's tools. Only the owner grants. A grant is used only by tasks the owner owns. always approves every call it covers; ask makes each call wait for a decision.

201.description: The grant. Replaying the same Idempotency-Key and body returns it again.

post.description: Stops the grant authorizing calls: the next call it covered is refused. Only the principal that granted it revokes it. If-Match carries the grant version.

get.description: Only the task owner may read the exact canonical tool input and digest before deciding. Other actors, including tenant readers, receive 404. The ETag is the attention version for the decision.

bearer.description: An OAuth 2.0 access token (typ at+jwt) from an operator-configured OpenID Connect issuer, bound to a principal of the tenant in the path.

Tenant.name: tenant
Tenant.description: The tenant; the bearer identity must be bound to a principal of it.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Client-chosen key, 1 to 128 bytes; the command nonce.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: The strong ETag of the record version the command was decided on.

After.name: after
After.description: Resume after this cursor; Last-Event-ID takes precedence.

LastEventID.name: Last-Event-ID
LastEventID.description: SSE resume cursor. A malformed or foreign cursor is answered with a reset.

ETag.description: Strong entity tag carrying the record version.

Problem503.description: Not available until the database is migrated: the binary serves an earlier schema during a rollout (ADR-0011). Retry after the migration.

MigrationView.description: The updated migration pass and its current preview evidence, when present.

Problem404.description: Not found, or not visible to the principal

Problem422.description: Invalid command, or Idempotency-Key reused with a different body
